description: This file defines the 'Command' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an AWS command object with methods for managing command data, handler list, authentication schemes, and metrics.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents an AWS command with properties for command name, handler list, auth schemes, and metrics, including methods for construction, cloning, and retrieving data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Command object with name, arguments, handler list, and metrics builder.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the handler list when the command object is cloned.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the command data.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list associated with the command.

methods.name: setAuthSchemes
methods.description: Sets authentication schemes for the command (deprecated).

methods.name: getAuthSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves authentication schemes for the command (deprecated).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Deprecated method to get a parameter value by name.

methods.name: getMetricsBuilder
methods.description: Returns the metrics builder associated with the command.
